data.notes: June 2026 is already anchored by Scorpios Mykonos’ official daily music program, with a few confirmed headline beach-club dates at Tropicana later in the month.

events.title: &ME, Ahmed Spins B2B Ankhoï
events.summary: Keinemusik’s &ME tops a Scorpios Terrace bill with Ahmed Spins B2B Ankhoï. The official program lists hypnotic builds and groove-led selections from 5:00 pm to midnight.

events.title: Bedouin, ATSOU
events.summary: Bedouin headline Scorpios’ Terrace with ATSOU. The official listing describes cross-cultural electronic sounds and global house selections.

events.title: Bedouin, Santiago Garcia
events.summary: Bedouin return to Scorpios’ Terrace with Santiago Garcia. The official description notes deep house and melodic techno elements for the sunset hours.

events.title: Damian Lazarus, LICA
events.summary: Damian Lazarus headlines Scorpios’ Terrace music program with LICA on support. The event is listed for 5:00 pm to midnight in Mykonos.

events.title: WhoMadeWho (Hybrid DJ Set), Lannka
events.summary: WhoMadeWho bring a Hybrid DJ Set to Scorpios’ Terrace with Lannka. The official program lists the event for 5:00 pm to midnight.

events.title: Lannka Invites Agoria, Kaytek
events.summary: Scorpios lists a Lannka Invites night with French electronic artist Agoria and Kaytek. The event is part of the Sunset Area music program.

events.title: Carlita, Jane Ryse
events.summary: Carlita appears on Scorpios’ Terrace program with Jane Ryse, whose listing highlights Afro House selections. The event runs from 5:00 pm to midnight.

events.title: Lannka Invites Henrik Schwarz (Live)
events.summary: Henrik Schwarz is listed for a live Lannka Invites performance at Scorpios. The program describes a crossover electronic set focused on versatile sound design.

events.title: Lannka Invites Parra For Cuva (Live)
events.summary: Parra For Cuva performs live for a Lannka Invites night at Scorpios. The listing frames the set around piano, synth and rhythm-led electronic productions.

events.title: ARKADYAN (Live), YEMANJO feat. Irene Rosalia (Live)
events.summary: Scorpios’ Sunset Area program pairs live sets from ARKADYAN and YEMANJO featuring Irene Rosalia. The listing emphasizes organic house, Afro-Balkanic and Latin/African influences.

events.title: El Búho feat. Sandra Bernardo (Live), RENATTA
events.summary: El Búho and Sandra Bernardo perform live at Scorpios with RENATTA. The listing highlights Latin American folk traditions fused with electronica and nature samples.

events.title: MoBlack B2B Jean Claude Ades
events.summary: MoBlack brings Afro-house and cross-cultural rhythms to Scorpios in a B2B with resident favourite Jean Claude Ades.

events.title: BISCITS
events.summary: Tropicana Mykonos lists BISCITS for a 16:30 beach-club event on June 20. The venue’s official events calendar includes reservation and VIP table options for this date.

events.title: Satori (Live), Meera
events.summary: A Scorpios Terrace music ritual pairing Satori’s groove-led live electronica with Meera’s Afro-influenced house selections.

events.title: Birds Of Mind
events.summary: Birds Of Mind play Alemagou with a listed focus on organic house, Afro house and tribal house at the open-air Ftelia beach venue.

events.title: Tripolism, LICA
events.summary: Tripolism bring their house, disco and techno blend to Scorpios, with LICA adding melodic house and techno selections.

events.title: Genesi • RBØR (Full Moon Night)
events.summary: Cavo Paradiso’s Full Moon Night closes June with Genesi and RBØR on the decks for a large-scale open-air club session.

events.title: Yero
events.summary: A Cavo Paradiso night built around deep grooves and hypnotic energy, positioned as a late-night dancefloor session rather than a mainstream headline show.
